| Kernel weight | 0.3469 | 0.2227 | -0.2485 | -0.6420 | -0.2485 | 0.2227 | 0.3469 |

The kernel for a horizontal vessel with sigma 1 and length 5. Across the vessel, u runs over the rows from -3 to 3, the window of 3 sigma. Along it, v runs over the columns from -2 to 2, since |v| must stay within 2.5. Every column of the window has the same profile, so the mean of the window is the mean of one column, -0.3580. Each weight is the profile minus this mean. The weights add up to 0, so a flat area gives 0 and a dark line along the middle row gives a large positive response. The square that holds every direction of the kernel is 9 x 9.
